segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You and Pip stand over the circular floorboards.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: With the stove lever engaged, the Roman numerals on the floor begin to hum with a soft, pulsing violet light. The number XIII clicks free.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You and Pip both grab the cold iron ring embedded in the numeral XIII and pull with all your strength.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The circular floorboards rotate with the heavy grind of ancient stone. A section of the floor slides open like a puzzle box, revealing a narrow flight of spiral stone stairs descending deep beneath the frozen river.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: From the darkness below rises the smell of cold river water, ozone, and old parchment.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip pulls his crooked hat down tight. His eyes are wide with wonder.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: It appears our little case has just officially gone underground.
